questions.question: In John's vision of the seven seals, what did the rider on the white horse with a bow and crown ride out to do?
When the Lamb opened the fourth seal in John's vision, what was the name of the rider on the pale green horse?
In John's vision, he saw the souls of people under the altar who had been slain. What had they been slain for?

answers.text: For the word of God and their testimony
For breaking the laws of their nation
For fighting in the armies of the king

questions.question: When the sixth seal was opened in John's vision, kings and slaves begged the mountains to fall on them. Who were they hiding from?

answers.text: The One on the throne and the Lamb
The four riders on the horses
